prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help. Below are several specific law firms that handle car-accident/personal-injury cases in Miami or statewide in Florida, and why you should consider calling each. After the list I’ll give a short call script and the key questions to ask so you can compare them quickly.

Recommended firms to call (and why)

1) Morgan & Morgan (has Miami/Florida presence)
- Why call: One of the largest plaintiff personal-injury firms in the U.S.; lots of resources, staff, and experience handling auto-accident claims and dealing with insurance companies. Good if you want a team with marketing reach and many attorneys/support staff available.

2) Kozyak Tropin & Throckmorton
- Why call: Well-known Miami firm with a strong track record in plaintiff litigation and major personal-injury matters. Good if you want a Miami-based firm with trial experience and a reputation for handling higher-value/complex cases.

3) Anidjar & Levine
- Why call: Florida-focused personal-injury firm that handles car accidents across the state. Often responsive, offers free consultations, contingency-fee arrangements, and experience with insurance negotiations and lawsuits.

4) Kanner & Pintaluga, P.A.
- Why call: Florida plaintiffs’ firm with experience in auto collisions and catastrophic injuries. Known for taking serious cases to trial when needed; good if your injuries are significant and you want lawyers comfortable with litigation and securing large verdicts/settlements.

5) Steinger Injury Lawyers (Steinger, Greene & Feiner / Steinger Injury Lawyers branding)
- Why call: Florida-based injury firm that advertises strong experience in auto-accident claims, typically responsive and experienced with injury investigations and maximizing insurance recovery.

6) Searcy Denney (Searcy Denney Scarola Barnhart & Shipley)
- Why call: Large Florida plaintiff firm that handles auto accidents and catastrophic injury cases statewide. Good for experienced litigators with resources to pursue cases to trial.

How to choose among them quickly
- Call at least 3 firms so you can compare responsiveness, fees, and strategy.
- Prefer firms that: offer a free consultation, work on contingency (no fee unless you recover), have trial experience, and have staff who will communicate clearly and timely.
- If you need Spanish or another language, ask about bilingual staff.

Short call script (what to say on first call)
- “Hi, I was in a car accident in [city/date]. I’m looking for a personal-injury lawyer. Do you take car-accident cases on contingency? Can I get a free consultation? I was injured and [brief description of injuries]. Are you able to help, and who would handle my case?”

Key questions to ask during the consult
- Do you handle car-accident cases typically in Miami courts/with Miami insurers?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (partner/associate/paralegal)?
- Do you take cases on contingency? What is your fee structure and any other costs I might be responsible for?
- Have you tried similar cases to verdict? Can you give a general sense of outcomes/settlement ranges for cases like mine?
- How do you communicate (phone/email/text), and how often will I get updates?
- Do you have investigators/medical experts you can call on?
- What is your expected timeline to resolution?

Practical next steps
- Call the firms above (search their Miami office phone numbers online or on the Florida Bar website).
- Have your accident date, basic injuries, medical provider names, and any police report info ready.
- If you want, tell me the Miami neighborhood/ZIP and a short description of the accident and your injuries. I can refine the list to include more local boutique firms or provide phone numbers and draft a short email or script for you.

If you want, I can also:
- Draft a 60–90 second script you can read on each call.
- Help evaluate answers you get from these firms and recommend which one to sign with.
